question: In the live whole-CNS LIF engine, untuned, does stimulating DNg75_R or DNa02_L (and, secondary, DNp09_R) give rhythmic front-left MN activity at 5-20 Hz, and if so does it need E1 and E2?
not_claimed: a change to the live engine, weights, mappings or motor admission
known_before: Rate model (R5, R1's sizes): DNg75_R 0.983, DNa02_L 0.926, DNp09_R 0.509 at ~13 Hz, needing E1/E2 not I1; none reached 0.5 with cord-only sizes. Live engine: only DNg100 tested (V1, tonic); V1's 20 control DNs exclude all three targets (best control scores 0.211, 0.217; p80 0.216). Before the design, identities and synapse counts onto front-left MNs were read from the cache (DNg75_R 167, DNa02_L 217, DNp09_R 0) and engine hashes were confirmed equal to V1's. No stimulation run.

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; V1 protocol.json and result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

engine: malecns_backend.neural.MaleCNSBrain(data), calibrated config, whole CNS as loaded, untuned (neural.py and brain_params.json hashes equal V1's)

conditions.harness: V1 (dng100_rhythm): simulate (Poisson forced-spike set_external_drive; brain.reset(seed); transmission_withheld_indices for silencing), score_simulation, best, readout and stimulus duration from V1's protocol
conditions.stim: each target at rates 25, 50, 100, 200 Hz, seeds 1-16
conditions.silencing: at each target's best rate (V1 rule: highest condition score, ties to lower rate): SIL_E1 (dense 142920), SIL_E2 (dense 143429), SIL_SHAM (R5 rule: R5 eligible local set for that target in R1's network = not DN/AN/front-left MN/E1/E2/I1/target's two-hop intermediates to the core; cell = default_rng(seed + 7,000,000) draw, mapped to dense via R1's net); seeds 1-16; skipped if the target has no feasible rate
conditions.watched: E1, E2, I1 spikes recorded alongside for reporting only; never enter the MN score
conditions.order: I2 first; then DNg75_R, DNa02_L, DNp09_R; per target rates ascending, then SIL_E1, SIL_E2, SIL_SHAM
conditions.total_simulations: 192 STIM + 48 per target with a feasible rate (<= 144) + 4 I2

readout: V1's: 68 front-left MNs (bodymap ' T1 left'), window 250-3000 ms, active MN >= 5 spikes, preprint rhythmicity score, condition score = mean over feasible seeds, frequency = median

acceptance.control_p80_source: V1 result.json control_p80 (20 random ACh DNs, best-rate rule; engine hash unchanged)
class_order: LIF_RHYTHM_CORE: rhythmic, best-rate frequency in [5, 20] Hz, SIL_E1 and SIL_E2 not >= 0.5 (NaN counts as not), SIL_SHAM >= 0.5
LIF_RHYTHM_OTHER: rhythmic, any of frequency/core/sham fails (reported)
acceptance.verdict: REPRODUCED_IN_LIF if both primaries LIF_RHYTHM_CORE; PARTIAL if any primary LIF_RHYTHM_CORE or LIF_RHYTHM_OTHER; else NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_LIF; DNp09_R reported alongside

reported_not_gated: per rate score, frequency, feasible seeds, active MNs, per-MN spike counts and scores
E1/E2/I1 spikes, mean rates and trace rhythmicity
recruited MNs vs DNg100's in V1

integrity.I1: source hashes; targets resolved from body IDs to the expected dense indices with instance names checked; E1/E2 equal V1's core copies; 68 front-left MNs equal V1's list; control p80 equals V1's stored value; sham eligible sets non-empty
integrity.I2: hard gate: DNg100_L 100 Hz seeds 1-4 equal V1's stored runs exactly (score and per-MN spike counts); else INCONCLUSIVE and nothing else runs
integrity.I3_tests: tests/test_lif_driver_rhythm.py passes (watch split; V1 aggregation; class order; verdict and expectations; sham mapping; I2 check)
integrity.I4: STIM 192 + 48 per feasible target simulations, plus 4 I2

expectations.note: recorded in the design before any L1 simulation; wrong ones are recorded as wrong

plumbing_disclosure: Before registration: one DNg100_L simulation at 100 Hz, seed 0 (not a protocol seed) was timed (6.62 s), its spikes not inspected; the I1 identity path (targets, core, MN list, sham eligible sets, two sham draws) was exercised without any simulation. Unit tests use toy inputs only.
execution: one command (--output) checks I1, runs I2 and all conditions, and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once in the background.
interpretation_limits: Three DNs chosen by the reconstructed rate model; other DNs untested.
Poisson forced-spike drive at four rates; the rate model used a constant input.
16 seeds per condition; specificity reference is V1's stored control distribution (only 2 of 20 controls feasible); no new controls.
Front-left MNs only; other legs not read.
Neural only: no body or physics; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
